title: Motion (Rodriguez - Blumenfield) relative to instructing the Department of City Planning, to report with recommended amendments to Chapter 1 and Chapter 1…
text:
[Council File 26-0262]
Motion (Rodriguez - Blumenfield) relative to instructing the Department of City Planning, to report with recommended amendments to Chapter 1 and Chapter 1 A, and any other relevant sections, to: 1) Create a clear and comprehensive definition of “Data Center”; and 2) Establish appropriate use classifications and zoning permissions for Data Centers; and related matters.
Community Impact Statement:
Yes For:
Palms Neighborhood Council
